system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: agristack_declare_crop and agristack_get_registry_status. For your information, my aadhaar_number is 100020002810, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_5093, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_6043.

function.name: agristack_get_registry_status
function.description: Returns comprehensive registry status including profile_status, number of linked parcels, verification status, and consent status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify any status. Fails if farmer not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: agristack_declare_crop
function.description: Declares a crop for a specific verified land parcel. Crop declaration is per-parcel, not global. Land must be in 'verified' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide advisory. Fails if land not verified or crop type unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
